trip: AX ODYCY Malta, Qawra Coast Road — 13–19 Oct 2026 (Deluxe sea view)

items.name: AX ODYCY Malta (the hotel)
items.address: Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
items.description: 4-star seafront resort (formerly AX Seashells Resort), ~565 rooms across Comfort/Deluxe/Suite categories including the booked Deluxe Sea View. Multiple pools incl. rooftop, waterpark, lido, and on-site restaurants (Minoa rooftop Mediterranean fusion, Deck & Keel buffet, Trattoria Riccardo, Mamacita, Cheeky Monkey Gastropub, Luzzu Maltese, Medusa Sky Bar, Sidestreet Lounge). Phone +356 2354 3000.
items.notes: Address, phone and room types from the operator's official pages. Hotel sits beside the Qawra bus stops and the promenade; Qawra Point beach is ~400 m.

items.name: Qawra–Buġibba–St Paul's Bay promenade
items.address: Seafront path directly outside AX ODYCY
items.description: Flat seafront promenade linking Qawra, Buġibba and St Paul's Bay — cafés, gelaterias and sunset views the whole way. The aquarium's own Qawra guide recommends the sunset stroll along the coast.
items.notes: Good morning-run and evening-walk route; continues to Buġibba square (~15–20 min walk from the hotel).

items.name: Qawra Point Beach
items.address: Qawra Point, beneath the National Aquarium headland
items.description: Small rocky swimming and snorkelling spot right by the hotel (TripAdvisor 4.1, ~130 reviews). Clear water, no sand — Maltese locals swim here; ladders/flat rocks for entry.
items.notes: Sea temp mid-Oct ≈ 22–24°C — swimmable. Rocky entry: water shoes help.

items.name: Malta National Aquarium
items.address: Triq it-Trunciera, Qawra (starfish-shaped building on the point)
items.description: The hotel-area's headline attraction: 51–54 themed tanks, ~250 species (Mediterranean natives, sharks, rays, jellyfish, reptiles), underwater-archaeology exhibit, Deep Explorer ride and hourly talks. TripAdvisor 4.0, ~4,900 reviews. Café/restaurant on site.
items.notes: Ticket prices shown on aggregator listings — buy at the official site/door. 5-minute walk from the hotel along the promenade.

items.name: Malta Classic Car Collection Museum
items.address: Tourist Street, Qawra (adjacent to AX ODYCY complex)
items.description: Private museum of restored vintage cars and automobilia — TripAdvisor 4.7 with ~2,000 reviews, one of the top-rated things to do in Qawra. Literally next door to the hotel.
items.notes: Rating/review count via TripAdvisor listing; entry price is a guide figure — confirm on site.

items.name: Café del Mar Malta (lido)
items.hours: Seasonal — daytime lido; evening events (verify October programme)
items.description: Infinity-pool lido at the aquarium complex with views over St Paul's Bay to St Paul's Island; hosts DJ evenings in season. ~850 m from the hotel.
items.notes: October programming not confirmed — check their socials. Listed as part of the Qawra attractions set by Malta Uncovered + the aquarium's own Qawra page.

items.name: Wignacourt Tower (St Paul's Bay)
items.address: Triq il-Knisja / seafront, St Paul's Bay (Buġibba side of the bay)
items.description: 1610 coastal watchtower built by Grand Master Wignacourt — the oldest surviving coastal tower in Malta, now a small interpretation centre. Part of the Qawra-area attractions list published by the National Aquarium.
items.notes: Build date (1610) from standard heritage sources; the aquarium page lists it among Qawra-area sights. ~25-min walk or short bus ride along the bay.

items.name: Buġibba Water Park
items.description: Free public water-play park on the Buġibba seafront — listed among Qawra-area attractions by the aquarium's own guide; mainly for kids, useful as a landmark when walking the promenade.
items.notes: Publicly owned facility; hours seasonal — may be quiet in mid-October.

items.name: Oracle Casino (Qawra)
items.description: One of Malta's licensed casinos, in the Qawra hotel district a short walk from AX ODYCY — slots and live tables. Listed among Qawra attractions by the aquarium's guide.
items.notes: 21+ / passport required at Maltese casinos (casino house rules vary — bring photo ID). Not verified independently this session.

items.name: Buġibba Square & Buġibba terminus
items.address: Buġibba bus terminus and square, ~1.2 km from AX ODYCY
items.description: The transport and nightlife hub of the north-east coast: main bus terminus (bays for 186, 212, TD1/TD5, 221/223 etc.), takeaways, bars, and the ferry terminal for Gozo Highspeed. The natural 'downtown' for the hotel stay.
items.notes: All major routes for the trip (186 to the venue, TD1 to the airport, 212 to Sliema) pass through Buġibba terminus or the Qawra seafront stops.
